title: Tunnell-type criteria for variants of the congruent number problem
summary: We study the $θ$-congruent number problem for $\cosθ=\pm3/5$ and $\pm4/5$ using the generalized theta series construction of Sirolli--Tornaría. We describe its specialization to newforms of weight $2$ over $\mathbb Q$ with nontrivial square-free odd part of the level, and explain the reduction of quadratic twists to odd fundamental discriminants. The same construction gives an effective procedure for every $θ$-congruent number problem with nonzero rational cosine.
